messages.subject: axis label superscript
parts:
Hi,

I want my label ylab("10^6 cells per ml") a bit nicer, in proper superscript. How can I do that?

Thanks!

messages.author: fcfcdcef61e0ccd5
messages.subject: Re: axis label superscript
parts:
Hi

Following will do it: (Ref: ?plotmath)

ylab(expression(10^6 * " cells per ml"))
